items.title: Josiah Gluck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 13, 2022
items.q: Were you on the “Night Music” series with David Sanborn when Sun Ra was there?

ctx.x: I did B.B. King I think and Patti Austin and then I mixed some other things that came in. I’d have to literally look at the credits to figure it out. But I don’t — no I didn’t do Joe’s thing.
Were you on the “Night Music” series with David Sanborn when Sun Ra was there?
No I only did the first half of the first season.
